research_question: Can the pinned text/UI environment produce byte-identical 1000-step action/tick chains across fresh processes for all two-family seed cells under a feasible pre-frozen runtime cap?

rationale.official_horizon: DiscoveryWorld Normal tasks use a 1000-step maximum in the fully read official paper
rationale.prior_failure: 20/20 cells timed out under 120 seconds and emitted no complete receipt
rationale.calibration: seed-0 chains were exact through 100 steps; median-based 1000-step projections were 121.58–121.61 seconds
rationale.selection: 180 seconds gives 58.39 seconds / 48.0% headroom over the higher median projection while fixing cumulative maximum wait at 3600 seconds

fixed_design.primary_success: 20 completed episodes, 20000 successful actions/ticks, 10/10 same-seed final and checkpoint chain pairs exact, no hidden keys, pinned commit
fixed_design.failure_handling: all timeout/crash/malformed cells remain failure; no retry, replacement, endpoint shortening, or exclusion

environment.execution: serial host subprocesses with sanitized env and Python socket denial; not OS-level DiscoveryWorld container isolation

endpoints.primary: 10/10 same-seed final and checkpoint chain pairs exact after 20/20 completed 1000-step episodes
endpoints.required_execution: 20000/20000 successful fixed actions and ticks, pinned commit, no hidden keys
endpoints.partial_failure: retain flushed progress and count cell failed; never promote partial chain to endpoint

falsifiers: any cell does not complete 1000 steps within 180 seconds
any action or tick is unsuccessful
any same-seed pair differs at a checkpoint or final chain
any hidden score key appears in observation
any episode runs a different repository commit
scope_limits: fixed rotate-only policy tests text/UI transition determinism, not task-solving behavior
no scorecard, task completion, correction gold, TREE/TYPED comparison or model
host subprocess network denial is Python-level, not a DiscoveryWorld Docker image certification
seeds and repeats are nested; n=2 task families
timeout selection is informed by exploratory calibration and is prospective only for this new protocol

exact_envelope.failure_policy: no retry, replacement, endpoint shortening, or post-hoc exclusion

approval.interpretation: not execution authority; separate explicit approval required

stopping_rule: execute exactly once only if approved; report PASS or FAIL and stop without repair
